Class DefaultSubscriberBuilder<T>

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.substrate.core.subscription.DefaultSubscriberBuilder<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of values delivered to the subscriber
All Implemented Interfaces:
SubscriberConfig<T>
public final class DefaultSubscriberBuilder<T> extends Object implements SubscriberConfig<T>
Mutable builder that implements SubscriberConfig and materializes a ConfiguredSubscriber via build().
